provenance: Empirical human visual inspection of staged activities & falls

positive_fall_events.description: Initial uncontrolled downward collapse from standing to floor surface
Secondary slip/collapse episode following shift on floor prior to seated recovery

negative_activity_intervals.activity: Controlled seated reading in armchair & forward reaching

matching_criteria.matching_rule: One-to-one bipartite temporal overlap matching: a prediction matches GT if it falls within [start - tol, end + tol], greedily assigned to nearest unassigned GT.
